_readme: Input to `npm run art-prompts -- art/prompts/sheet-6-manifest.json 6`. The 11 deck-local filler/synergy Characters authored during plan step 4.0a's opponent re-pointing (PT-32) and its 4.0a-correction follow-up — none of these were ever in a prompt sheet, since they live as deck-file extras (src/cards/data/decks/{lovelace,nellAshby,adler,jekyll,christie,prudenceHollis}.ts) outside the labeled 60 ALL_CARDS set that ss-art-prompts's normal card-by-card sweep covers. Confirmed missing by diffing every artId referenced in src/cards/data/ against public/art/manifest.json's 93 entries (83 referenced, 11 missing, all here) — same class of gap 3.2's own sheet-5 fix already found once for reward/easter-egg cards; this is that gap recurring for a newer batch of deck-file extras. Family reference images point at the same roster portraits every prior sheet has used, so these land visually consistent with the existing cast; a few rows also note a second, opponent-specific portrait worth attaching by hand for extra continuity, since the row's family (for palette purposes) and its owning opponent aren't always the same person.

rows.prompt: Bust-to-waist portrait of an industrial Foundry furnace stoker, sleeves rolled to the elbow, soot-dusted forearms, feeding coal into a roaring firebox just out of frame, a steady, incurious expression — a man who has learned not to ask what the machine is for. Warm brass-and-copper key light from the furnace's own glow, cog-work and rivets rendered with real engineering logic. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight with real cast shadows. Background a soft blur of furnace machinery and rising heat-shimmer.
rows.notes: Ada Lovelace's deck filler (src/cards/data/decks/lovelace.ts, plan step 4.0a) — "Keeps the fire hot and the gears turning. Asks no questions." Attaches portrait-ada-lovelace as the Foundry reference, already her own portrait.

rows.prompt: Bust-to-waist portrait of a sharp-eyed Irregulars information broker, a satchel of letters and telegrams slung across one shoulder, several envelopes fanned in one hand as if sorting them mid-stride, a knowing half-smile. Warm gaslight-amber key light from a street lamp, cool blue-grey ambient shadow fill. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight with real cast shadows. Background a soft blur of a busy postal corner, pigeons and passers-by indistinct.
rows.notes: Old Nell Ashby's deck filler (src/cards/data/decks/nellAshby.ts, plan step 4.0a / 4.0a-correction) — "Exchanges letters across the city and never misses a detail worth noting." Attaches portrait-old-nell-ashby as the Irregulars reference, already her own portrait.

rows.prompt: Bust-to-waist portrait of a nimble young Irregulars messenger girl caught mid-run, skirts hitched for speed, a folded note clutched tight, glancing back over one shoulder as if already planning her way home. Warm gaslight-amber key light, cool blue-grey ambient shadow fill emphasizing motion. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight with real cast shadows. Background a soft blur of a narrow street receding behind her.
rows.notes: Old Nell Ashby's deck filler (src/cards/data/decks/nellAshby.ts, plan step 4.0a / 4.0a-correction) — "Carries urgent messages through every street and always finds her way back to the bar." Attaches portrait-old-nell-ashby as the Irregulars reference.

rows.prompt: Bust-to-waist portrait of a charming Rookery trickster mid-flourish, a coin balanced on the back of one hand about to vanish, an easy, disarming smile, a sharply cut oxblood-leather waistcoat. Warm gaslight key light, deep oxblood-leather tones dominant, cool ambient fill. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight with real cast shadows. Background a soft blur of a crowded pub corner, easy to vanish into.
rows.notes: Irene Adler's deck-local card (src/cards/data/decks/adler.ts, plan step 4.0a / 4.0a-correction), Rookery half of her Rookery+Irregulars deck — "A coin vanishes. A watch reappears. Everyone stays friends." This sheet's Rookery default reference is Reg Farrow's portrait (family palette continuity); also worth attaching portrait-irene-adler by hand for continuity with the opponent this card actually belongs to.

rows.prompt: Bust-to-waist portrait of a watchful Irregulars informant leaning in a shadowed doorway, one hand extended slightly, palm up, an expectant look, ear angled as if still listening to something just out of frame. Warm gaslight-amber key light from a nearby lamp, cool blue-grey ambient shadow fill. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight with real cast shadows. Background a soft blur of a fog-wrapped alley mouth.
rows.notes: Irene Adler's deck-local card (src/cards/data/decks/adler.ts, plan step 4.0a / 4.0a-correction), Irregulars half of her deck — "Hears everything. Forgets nothing. rows.prompt: Bust-to-waist portrait of a quick, light-footed Irregulars courier already turning away mid-delivery, a sealed message just released from her fingers, cloak flaring with the motion, a fleeting backward glance. Warm gaslight-amber key light, cool blue-grey ambient shadow fill suggesting quick motion. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight with real cast shadows. Background a soft blur of a street corner she's already leaving.

rows.prompt: Bust-to-waist portrait of an impeccably dressed Salon society patron, silk cravat and tailored coat, a politely incurious expression, one gloved hand resting on the back of a brocade chair. rows.prompt: A small circle of Salon ladies seated around a low table with teacups and an unread novel, caught mid-conversation rather than mid-reading, warm and conspiratorial, verdigris-green brocade upholstery throughout. Warm gaslight key light with cool verdigris-green ambient fill. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight with real cast shadows. rows.notes: Agatha Christie's deck-local card (src/cards/data/decks/christie.ts, plan step 4.0a-correction, PT-32) — "Meets Tuesdays, ostensibly for Trollope. Nobody has finished a Trollope in years." Also worth attaching portrait-agatha-christie by hand alongside the default Hollis Salon reference. A group card, not a single-figure portrait — style-bible.md's Character framing still applies (bust-to-waist-equivalent, no full-room wide shot).
